name: cert5
technique: adaptive gate elimination (Lemma F + Theorem N), level m = 1

symmetry.name: sigma
symmetry.description: byte rotation of the 32 signal indices: i -> 8*((i//8 + 1) mod 4) + (i mod 8). The checker verifies it is an automorphism of the supplied matrix; nothing else about the matrix is assumed.

e_K_provenance.status: ESTABLISHED BY EXHAUSTIVE SEARCH, NOT BY A SHORT CERTIFICATE
e_K_provenance.statement: minE(K) >= 5, i.e. no set of 4 or fewer extra masks completes M|_K.
e_K_provenance.method: depth-4 exhaustion of the extras tree by the searcher shipped here as mine.c

runs.implementation: unpruned C searcher (an independent referee's own code path)
pruned Python searcher (the originating lane's code path)

e_K_provenance.agreement: both implementations report the identical root state (free closure 24/32, |avail| = 38, 511 root candidates); every branch index 0..510 covered exactly once by each; all 228 shard files end SHARD-DONE ... NO-COMPLETION
e_K_provenance.historical_cost: 16 workers on one machine, 114 shards per certificate, run to completion twice
e_K_provenance.reproducible_here: the searcher shipped in this directory, run single-threaded with both of its documented prunings, exhausts the same depth-4 tree in 1.90e9 nodes / 166 s on one core. That run is the pruned code path (the same one the lane used); the 9.43e10-node UNPRUNED exhaustion is the independent confirmation and remains a cited external run.

negative_control.purpose: a recorded FAILING keep-set, so that the realizability predicate in the checker can be shown to agree with the one the exhaustion used
negative_control.name: cert1
negative_control.meaning: M|_cert1 IS completable with 4 extras, so minE(cert1) = 4 exactly and cert1 yields only 1+18+32+4 = 55. Eleven of the twelve tested certificates died this way; cert5 is the survivor.

sources.referee_report: the referee report on the 55, plus its same-day addendum recording the depth-4 run
